name: CopyBlocker Pro
author: sadathossen

sections.description:
CopyBlocker Pro protects your WordPress site by preventing users from selecting, copying, pasting, or inspecting content. With a retro-themed, user-friendly settings interface, you can toggle features like:

  • Disabling text selection
  • Blocking copy (Ctrl+C / Cmd+C) and paste (Ctrl+V / Cmd+V)
  • Preventing select all (Ctrl+A / Cmd+A)
  • Blocking developer tools/inspect (Ctrl+Shift+I / Cmd+Opt+I)
  • Disabling right-click context menu

The plugin supports multiple languages, including Bangla, and is designed for ease of use with a modern retro aesthetic.

sections.installation:
1. Upload the copyblocker-pro folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
  3. Navigate to Settings > CopyBlocker Pro to configure restrictions.
sections.faq:
Can I enable restrictions on specific pages?

Currently, the plugin applies to all pages. Contact the author for customizations.

Is the plugin translatable?

Yes, CopyBlocker Pro is translation-ready and includes support for languages like Bangla (bn_BD).
sections.changelog:
1.0.3

  • Fixed “The link you followed has expired” error by simplifying nonce handling for form submission and securing redirect nonce.
  • Updated admin CSS with enhanced retro styling for settings page, tooltips, submit button, and Buy Me a Coffee button.

1.0.2

  • Removed unnecessary load_plugin_textdomain() call for WordPress.org compatibility.
  • Escaped status message output to prevent potential XSS vulnerabilities.
  • Fixed settings saving and application by improving script enqueue logic.
  • Corrected admin CSS enqueue path and added settings error display.
  • Ensured frontend scripts do not run in admin area to prevent interference.
  • Fixed issue where unchecked settings still applied restrictions by ensuring integer values and strict JavaScript checks.
  • Added nonce verification for settings-updated check to address Plugin Check warning.
  • Replaced direct database query in uninstall.php with get_sites() for WordPress compliance.
  • Scoped custom font (Press Start 2P) to plugin settings page to prevent affecting other admin areas.

1.0.0

  • Initial release with controls for disabling text selection, copying, pasting, select all, developer tools, and context menu.
  • Modern retro settings UI with tooltips and translation support.
